title: Find Common Items in Two Lists
question: Print the unique values that appear in both lists, preserving the order of the first list.
code:
first = [1, 2, 3, 4, 2]
second = [2, 4, 6]
common = []
for item in first:
    if item in second and item not in common:
        common.append(item)
print(common)
explanation: Check membership in the second list and avoid adding the same common item more than once.
